title: Verify provider, registry, staging, and approved consumer rollout gates

gate_a_source_build.evidence: uv build exited 0; current tdt-core tree has untracked graphify-out/ and tdt-core entries, so clean-tree precondition is not proven.

gate_b_artifact.evidence: Installed environment matched distribution/runtime 0.2.0 and registry counts 1/12/2; tdt --help and doctor help passed, but tdt --version exited 2 because the canonical option is not implemented; doctor on real ~/.tdt reports findings.

gate_c_publication.evidence: No approved registry coordinate, publication receipt, registry download, or digest comparison.

gate_d_consumer.evidence: No approved target or consumer candidate install; all 12 consumers remain blocked preflight.

gate_e_ecosystem.evidence: Zero consumers promoted and zero reverse rollback rehearsals completed; participant scope record exists but is not completion evidence.

finding: Release gates fail closed. The local build and selected installed checks do not establish publication, consumer readiness, or ecosystem completion.
